links.outcome: Agreement between clinician consensus and LLM judge on safe/unsafe chatbot suicide risk handling in simulated conversations
links.effect: Clinician interrater reliability 0.77; LLM judge vs clinician consensus reliability 0.81; ratings stable across judge LLMs.
links.quote: The LLM judge was strongly aligned with this clinical consensus reference (interrater reliability=0.81) when using the same scoring rubric.

unlisted_practices: Automated LLM-as-judge benchmark for evaluating chatbot suicide risk detection and response, validated against clinician consensus
Simulated user-agents spanning suicide risk levels and disclosure styles for chatbot safety testing

screen.reason: The study validates an automated safety evaluation tool/benchmark (VERA-MH) for AI chatbot suicide risk detection and response against expert clinician safety ratings using simulated multi-agent interactions.

primary.practice: automated safety evaluation and suicide risk detection benchmarking
